question: What claim about the totality of fields is entailed by relating the group of all fields to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: The group of all fields belongs to them.
inference: The total group of fields is assigned to the class of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The verse does not specify the nature of the relation between yoginīs and their fields.
plain_english: The group of all fields of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
